title: Meta and TikTok let harmful content rise after evidence outrage drove engagement - whistleblowers - BBC News
summary: Whistleblowers claim Meta and TikTok allowed harmful content to proliferate, especially involving minors, due to alleged political content prioritization. Criticisms focus on the company's moderation system and its handling of sensitive content, with concerns raised about the safety of young users and the company's responsiveness to internal concerns.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to concerns over content prioritization and the alleged lack of responsiveness to harmful content involving minors.
